Reading time: `r ifelse(file.size("index.qmd")/2000 < 1, '<1 minute', paste0(round(file.size("index.qmd")/2000), ' minutes'))`

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
bird <- read_delim('BirdDB.txt', delim=';') 
bird <- bird %>%
    mutate(
        Week = factor(week(Date)),
        Month = factor(month(Date), label=T),
        Day = wday(Date, label=T),
        Hour = hour(Time)
    )
```

```{r}
bird %>%
    mutate(species_abbrev = fct_lump_n(Com_Name, n=10, other_level="Other")) %>%
    group_by(Week, species_abbrev) %>%
    summarize(n=n()) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Week, y = n, fill = species_abbrev)) +
    geom_col() + 
    scale_fill_viridis_d(name = 'Species', option = 'magma') + 
    facet_wrap(~species_abbrev, ncol=3)

```

# top 10 with pics


# anna vs rufous hummingbird

```{r}
bird %>%
    filter(Com_Name %in% c('Anna\'s Hummingbird', 'Rufous Hummingbird')) %>%
    group_by(Week, Com_Name) %>%
    summarize(n=n()) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Week, y = n, fill = Com_Name)) +
    geom_col(position = 'dodge') + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = c('Anna\'s Hummingbird'='chartreuse3','Rufous Hummingbird'='chocolate2')) 

```
